rationale:
The reviewed tests adequately check `requirements.sdk.graph.agent-calls.judge`. I judged this from the requirement text and the supplied test source. I did not request any implementation source. The refining sub-requirements (`node_contents`, `phases`, `rendering`, `submission`, `caching`) are assessed separately, so I mapped only the top-level obligations.

- **`ctx.ask::<R>()` starts an independent request through a shared reference.**
  - `shared_context_allows_independent_concurrent_agent_calls` runs two builders from one `&ctx` concurrently under `futures::join!`. A barrier of 2 forces both calls to be in flight at once.
  - It asserts that both calls return their own results (7 and 11) and that two agent requests were made.
  - Many other tests also start several builders from one context.

- **`context(value)` appends reusable text to the prefix.**
  - `contexts_render_once_allow_non_send_values_and_hash_exact_prefix_text` chains `.context(&context)` and `.context((String, String))`. It asserts the exact joined prefix, `"héllo\n\npolicy\n\nquestion"`.
  - `explicit_insertions_preserve_order_repetition_and_selection_snapshots` also uses `.context(String)` and asserts the prefix `"question"`.

- **`current_node_contents()` and `successors_content(label)` are available from both phases and enter the node phase.**
  - From `ContextPhase`: `current_node_contents` is used in `shared_context_allows_independent_concurrent_agent_calls`, and `successors_content` is used directly in `queued_reads_selection_and_rendering_fail_before_agent_invocation`.
  - From `NodePhase`: `explicit_insertions_preserve_order_repetition_and_selection_snapshots` chains `.current_node_contents().successors_content(7).current_node_contents()`. It asserts the order and repetition of the inserted contents.
  - The dropped-builder test chains the two calls in the opposite order.

- **Both states implement `IntoFuture` with a `Send` future and `Output = Result<R, ValidationError<_>>`.**
  - `assert_send` is applied to a `ContextPhase` future in `contexts_render_once_allow_non_send_values_and_hash_exact_prefix_text`. It is applied to a `NodePhase` future in `explicit_insertions_preserve_order_repetition_and_selection_snapshots`.
  - `.unwrap()` on the awaited result covers the success case. The `Err` cases are asserted as `ValidationError::Graph("read")`, `ValidationError::Graph("edges")`, `ValidationError::Graph("render")` and `ValidationError::NoAgentConfigured`.

- **Awaiting executes the assembled request even with no contexts or node insertions.**
  - `ctx.ask::<Answer>().await.unwrap()` and `.context(Vec::<String>::new()).await` are both awaited in `contexts_render_once_allow_non_send_values_and_hash_exact_prefix_text`.
  - The test asserts that the agent received those requests, each with an empty prefix, a fingerprint of the empty string and no node contents.

- **Building does not invoke an agent.**
  - `queued_reads_selection_and_rendering_fail_before_agent_invocation` builds and drops a builder, then asserts that `agent.requests` is empty.
  - `dropped_builders_and_missing_agents_do_not_resolve_queued_inputs` shows that a dropped builder records no dependencies. It also shows that an await with no agent configured fails with `NoAgentConfigured` before any graph reads or selections happen.

No obligation in the top-level text lacks a test that exercises it and asserts the outcome. No acknowledgments apply.
